title: Hierarchy of Effects of Laboratory Markers and Their Interaction With Comorbidity Concerning Outcome and Personalized Treatment of Trauma Patients in Emergency Care and Rehabilitation
official: Hierarchy of Effects of Laboratory Markers and Their Interaction With Comorbidity Concerning Outcome and Personalized Treatment of Trauma Patients in Emergency Care and Rehabilitation
summary: At least ten percent of trauma patients suffer from any sort of complication. The study aims to identify a risk factor profile to early identify trauma patients at risk.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* acute long bone fracture (humerus, ulna, radius, femur, tibia) with surgical treatment

Exclusion Criteria:

* associated severe injury (ISS \> 16)
* associated traumatic brain injury
* associated traumatic spine injury
* dementia
